# Open Ethics Standard

> A local MCP server (`npx -y open-ethics-standard-mcp@latest`, Node.js 20+) that lets an AI coding assistant diagnose harmful practices (dark patterns, privacy traps, billing tricks) in a project, backed by the open Open Ethics Standard catalog. Reports are saved on the user's machine; findings never leave it. No account or API key required.

- [Agent guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): The review workflow, report format, and reply format. Start here.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/open-ethics-standard-mcp): The local stdio MCP server and catalog CLI.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): Canonical practice definitions.
- [Source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source and contribution guide.
